GOLF ADVISORY COMMITTEE AGENDA
  THURSDAY, MARCH 12, 2026
  2760 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  PRM ADMINISTRATION, LARGE CONFERENCE ROOM, 2:30 PM

Kevin Fitzgerald, Chair  Jim Demetriou, Member
Larry Conkings, Vice Chair  Robert Meliere, Member
Clifford Aichele, Member  Joyce Ricci, Member
Stevie Anderson, Member  Angie Young, Member
Donna Barrett, Member

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments
  to Lilia.Romero@LongBeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-54552  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Golf Advisory Committee meeting
  of Thursday, December 4, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

2.  26-54553  Recommendation to receive and file the City Golf Operations oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

3.  26-54554  Recommendation to receive and file the American Golf oral updates on the
  courses, capital improvement projects, and other items.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

4.  26-54555  Recommendation to discuss and, if appropriate, recommend the Director request
  City Council approval of proposed updates to the Long Beach Players’ Club, as
  endorsed by the Fees and Charges Ad Hoc Committee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

5.  26-54556  Recommendation to discuss and, if appropriate, recommend the Director approve
  the proposed Golf Fees and Charges schedule for 2026-2027, as endorsed by the
  Fees and Charges Ad Hoc Committee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

6.  26-54557  Recommendation to receive and file an update from American Golf on the
  implementation of a feedback survey to receive public input on golf course

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

7.  26-54558  Recommendation to review and submit to the Mayor and City Council an annual
  written report of the Golf Advisory Committee activities for the 2025 calendar year.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

8.  26-54559  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion of the proposed 2026 state

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

9.  26-54560  Recommendation to receive and file a report from current Ad Hoc Committees,
  discuss anticipated Ad Hoc Committees for upcoming projects; and, if appropriate,
  take action to dissolve or create Ad Hoc Committees.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Golf Advisory Committee on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited
to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Lilia Romero, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact Lilia Romero at 562.570.3104 or
Lilia.Romero@LongBeach.gov
